description.value:
Your marrow banks a coal-warmth that never quite goes out.

Gift — Immune to the early stages of environmental cold exposure; no extra layers needed in cold climates. Tithe — You run warm: thermal-sensing creatures and instruments find you easily, and Deception to feign death or feign cold takes a −2 circumstance penalty.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Deception to feign death or feign cold takes a −2 circumstance penalty" has no confirmed rule-element hook: Deception has no formal 'feign death/cold' sub-action (unlike Impersonate, Feint, or Create a Diversion, which do have real action-slug predicates -- confirmed via grep across pf2e-source/packs), so a scoped penalty can't be predicated without either missing the restriction entirely or over-applying it to all Deception checks, which would misstate a narrow penalty as a blanket one.
